chosen_args.why_stop: The stopping rule is satisfied. candidate_13 is feasible and is the lowest-cost optimized candidate. The only higher-activity candidates, candidate_04 and candidate_05, were optimized and are more expensive. All unoptimized candidates are screened by the declared rule because they have both lower reference activity and higher metal price than candidate_13. Since candidate_04 has the highest atomic activity but is not the industrial choice, BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY were executed; the required 201.22x activity gain is unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. Remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value relative to the now-stable ranking; the remaining high-value validity checks are not affordable.
